core: standards, browser implementations, and Web APIs

claims.claim: Web APIs are interfaces available while developing a web app or site.
HTML user agents such as browsers parse HTML markup into a DOM.
Web IDL is an interface definition language used to describe interfaces developers use in web applications.
Feature detection tests whether a capability is available before code uses it, which lets a site choose a fallback path.
The web platform is best understood as interoperating specifications and browser-provided capabilities, rather than as a single JavaScript library.
